summary: Comprehensive testing of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) feature for wedding gallery admin panel. All 2FA flows tested and working: setup with QR code, enable with TOTP verification, login with 2FA, recovery codes, and disable. Rate limiting updated to 3 attempts/30 minutes. Backend: 7/7 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements working correctly.
passed_tests: Admin login works normally (without 2FA enabled) - username 'admin', password 'test123'
2FA status endpoint returns enabled:false when not set up
2FA setup endpoint returns QR code (base64 PNG), secret (base32), and provisioning URI
2FA enable with invalid code returns 400 'Invalid code'
2FA enable with valid TOTP code returns {enabled: true, recovery_codes: [...]}
After enabling 2FA, login without code returns {requires_2fa: true}
After enabling 2FA, login with wrong code returns 401
After enabling 2FA, login with valid TOTP code returns token
Recovery code login works (code consumed after use)
2FA disable with valid TOTP code works
After disabling 2FA, normal login works again
Rate limiting: 3 failed attempts trigger 30-minute lockout message
Frontend: Settings page shows Two-Factor Auth tab
Frontend: 2FA tab shows 'Enable 2FA' button when disabled
Frontend: 2FA setup shows QR code and manual secret
Frontend: Verification code input field present
Frontend: Dashboard loads with gallery stats (2 galleries, 19 files)
Frontend: Share access page loads correctly
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing galleries and share tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA feature fully tested and working. Complete flow: setup (QR+secret) -> enable (TOTP verify) -> login with 2FA -> recovery codes -> disable. Rate limiting is 3 attempts/30 minutes. 2FA is currently DISABLED for admin account (left in clean state). pyotp library used for TOTP generation. Recovery codes are 8-char uppercase hex strings. Frontend has Two-Factor Auth tab in Settings with full setup/enable/disable UI.

features_verified.recovery_codes: 8 codes generated, each 8-char uppercase hex, single-use
features_verified.frontend_2fa_tab: Settings > Two-Factor Auth tab with full UI
features_verified.frontend_qr_display: QR code and manual secret displayed during setup

mocked_apis.PayPal: Uses paypal.me redirect link (not API integration)
